caption:
Six layout rules are checked on the rendered page after every edit.

We measure the actual rendered output across six baseline requirements: single-column order, standard headings, real bullet lists, selectable text, no tables or floats, and body text of at least 9.5pt.

This check is structural enforcement, not a certification against any ATS vendor. It keeps the exported document clean and consistently formatted.

Read more at jobrez.com.
